description: This file defines a REST API resource for self-service access to savings accounts within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving account details, transaction history, charges, and account modification commands, with access control based on user mappings.

classes.name: SelfSavingsApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing self-service endpoints for savings accounts, including retrieval, charges, transactions, and updates, with user access validation.

methods.name: retrieveSavings
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific savings account, validating user access and optional associations.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific savings account transaction after access validation.

methods.name: retrieveAllSavingsAccountCharges
methods.description: Lists charges associated with a savings account, with filtering options.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific savings account charge.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template for creating or modifying a savings account, validating client-user mapping.

methods.name: submitSavingsAccountApplication
methods.description: Submits a new savings account application after validating input and user mapping.

methods.name: modifySavingsAccountApplication
methods.description: Updates an existing savings account, with validation.

methods.name: validateAppuserSavingsAccountMapping
methods.description: Checks if the logged-in user is mapped to the specified savings account.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Checks if the logged-in user is mapped to the specified client.
